description: Called a relief column the worst place God made, and kept the three kinds of news apart.
name: George Bryan

description: Reported the pressing as road talk, and the Rose bill as a title with no receipt.
name: William Blackwage, Ralph Raye, Richard Hoope

description: Called the yard thin and named no sum.
name: Goodwife Margery Pell

description: Said Rome sells, and let you leave without admiring it.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Had brought the letter. He was not in this stretch. The sheet was his cousin's.
name: William Sly

description: Read the title and did not cross to the Rose.
name: William Shakespeare
